headline: European AI is in a capital boom (record H1 2026, Mistral's €3bn round, Helsing's $1.8bn), regulation has eased, and a large block of Horizon Europe Apply AI and robotics calls opens on 2026-11-17.
outlook_reason: Record European AI venture funding, delayed AI Act high-risk obligations and many open EU calls favour commercialisation, although capital is concentrated in a few large rounds.

signals.title: Saidot raises a new round led by BackingMinds
signals.detail: The Helsinki AI governance platform raised an undisclosed amount. Existing investors Crowberry Capital and Ventic took part. The money is for European growth, US entry and policy-as-code product work.

signals.title: October 2026 European seed rounds: Machenta $40m, Rivercell $25m
signals.detail: Machenta (London) is building robot-learning models that learn from a single demonstration. Vestbee's list is mixed, so treat it as indicative.

signals.title: Mistral AI raises €3bn Series D
signals.detail: Samsung-led round at about €21bn post-money, reported by Euronews and EUACC.

signals.title: HumanX/Crunchbase: record US$23bn of European AI VC in H1 2026
signals.detail: AI took 55% of European VC. Capital is highly concentrated: 73% went to 38 large rounds.

signals.title: AI Act Digital Omnibus (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) in force
signals.detail: Delays high-risk obligations to Dec 2027 (Annex III) and Aug 2028 (Annex I). Exact dates are not yet checked on EUR-Lex.

signals.title: EuroHPC AI Gigafactories tender closes 2026-11-12
signals.detail: The tender is for up to seven AI gigafactories, with awards expected in early 2027. This is a reported item from an aggregator; verify before use.
